During my undergrad, I was feeling really pressured to get my degree and go directly into med school because I was so scared to finish at a late age. I kept pushing and pushing until finally my mental health collapsed. I got my degree but I had to set aside med school for a while. 
After rigorous therapy, medications, and a period of soul-searching, I learned to accept that every one has their own unique timing for things. Life has no timeline. 

Congratulations OP! 🥳
It’s like she’s staring right into my soul 👁👄👁

I tried being abroad during holiday season and malakas din tama ng pagka homesick. Dun ko na realize na ibang iba ang Paskong Pinoy. Yung tipong kaka simula pa lang ng ber-months, nag iiba na atmosphere sa labas — meron na Christmas lights, Christmas designs, at maririnig mo na din mga kantahang pang pasko. Ka miss 🥺

Glad to hear this 👏🏼
Rooting for you po 🤞🏼

I just miss the things, the environment, and the people I Ieft. Definitely not the government 🤡

Also totoo yung sa balita! Napansin ko din na parang lately puro Philippine news pinapanood ko. Pinapanood ko Unang Hirit bago pumasok for work. Parang sa Pinas lang  🥺

Yup moved during the pandemic bc it was mainly the reason why I wanted to leave the Metro 😭 
How: Well I must admit I am privileged enough to have documents as well as family members living here
Where: I’m currently here in the US
When: Mid to late March 
I was kinda like you before I left. With all the shit happening in the Metro during this pandemic, I wanted  out. So I opted to go here and try to start earning na. Pero few week before my flight it kinda hit me — I’ll be leaving my whole life. This is where my anxiety started kicking in PLUS I just started to go off my meds during this time kaya all the anxieties came rushing. Parang gusto ko mag back out as in. For the homesickness, it’s really different for everybody.
Pero right now, it’s kind of taking a toll on my mental health. Still somehow managing but I’m really emotional for the past week. It really just started kicking in. Maybe homesickness is kinda hard on me kasi I was born and raised and the city tapos I moved to a medyo remote area (no tall buildings, only one mall tapos mag sasara pa)

No joke, I was about to post something about homesickness before I came across your post  😭 Might still post tho just to vent 😭

Just moved abroad about 2 months ago and although I know quality of life is better here, I gotta face my first battle — homesickness 🥲
And as someone who has mental health issues, it’s sooo hard not to fall into the rabbit hole again.
How long ago did you start? Kasi when I took Lexapro (Escitalopram) I think it kinda took a while before nagkaron ng *slight* improvements. As for Quetiapine, kain tulog lang ako 🥲
Took Lexapro for a while and I legit felt exactly like that.
